scope: Reuse at most four exactly bound successfully decoded NTFS compression units.

implementation.budget: 4x64KB heap payloads globally plus bounded static metadata; Loading/Retiring keep their slot until actual completion/free. Existing128KB per-read scratch and serialized fallback preserved.
implementation.identity: Exact admitted mount ref, parent mount/content revision, file record, copied UTF16 stream, unit and attribute sizes/flags. All write invalidations advance content even if metadata survives; checked revision overflow disables reuse.
implementation.ownership: Short existing owner1 metadata admission; exact noncopy pins protect immutable data outside owner. No allocation/free/IO/caller copy under metadata owner. Complete decode/zero-fill and revision recheck precede publication. Duplicate fill/OOM fall back to the original read.
implementation.reclaim: Original memory reclaim prelude and exact mount-forget retire only unpinned Ready entries. Real heap-free acknowledgement before slot reset. No new PMM truth or invented frame release count.
implementation.preserved: Raw/sparse/resident paths, original LZNT1, initialized_size/zeros/EOF/error oracles, existing mounted shared read/exclusive writer admission, public API/ABI, SDK/Contract, STANDARD/ref/lifecycle child.

host.scope: Actual new decoded owners and original metadata cache/IO/attribute reader/LZNT1/types. Only heap/metadata admission and disk callbacks modeled. Cold/hot exact data, exact identity/revision,4pins/budget/reclaim/LRU reuse, OOM/loading reentry/revision abort, actual write invalidation, initialized/error/raw/sparse and real frees.

receipts.rename_replacement: original compressed file restored; newly created replacement deleted
receipts.mount: new exact partition target/ref, stale old ref
receipts.oracles: Original initialized29 boundaries including cross-unit, logical zeros, raw, sparse, EOF/canary and malformed prefix checks retained.

scoped_guest.limits: One bounded SMP4 group; host tests model lower admission/IO/heap primitives. No universal timing improvement or all media/concurrency proof. Global passive IO-copy counters complement exact owner tests.

source_audit.preserved: All other Rust files/functions, raw/sparse input geometry branches, old metadata invalidation bodies after private content-stamp bump; original initialized29 oracle and fixture, STANDARD workload/reference, public API/ABI, SDK/Contract.
source_audit.reclaim_equivalence: Only bounded decoded-unit release prelude; original exact frame receipts and all following work identical.
source_audit.limits: Source preservation and targeted owner boundaries complement one native fixture group; not universal interleavings/media or elapsed speedup proof.

comparison_previous.observation: One final run per artifact; descriptive comparison without causal gain/parity claim. All deltas retained, unchanged workload/reference, no score-selection rerun.

performance_assessment: Read/decode/residency changes may affect runtime; exactly one final Suite2 STANDARD SMP4 and original full DevCenter5/30/6valid readback required. This standard workload does not fully measure this specialized compressed-read path; avoided copies/decodes are not wall-time gains.
test_policy: Reuse initialized fixture/oracles and one bounded native group; actual-source host cases only concrete pin, admission, invalidation, allocation and decoder boundaries. No broad catalog or extra measurement campaign.
limits: Host lower heap/IO/admission are modeled; one native QEMU SMP4 group is not all interleavings/media failures. Private content invalidation is conservatively volume-wide. Hits retain original scratch cost.
